   586: typedef struct CPreprocessResult CPreprocessResult;
   587: struct CPreprocessResult
   588: {
   589:     CToken* tokens;
   590:     // Base of the spelling space every token offset points into.
   591:     char8 const* spelling_base;
   592:     // Null for hand-built results; token locations then recover as zero.
   593:     CSourceMapRecovery* recovery;
   594:     // The identifier intern table the tokens' symbol ids point into; arena
   595:     // resident so parse and lowering can intern on demand. Null for
   596:     // hand-built results.
   597:     CSymbolTable* symbols;
   598:     CDiagnostic* diagnostics;
   599:     String8* files;
   600:     // Sorted (token index, alignment) spans replacing a per-token field;
   601:     // null with count 0 for hand-built results, which query as alignment 0.
   602:     CPackAlignment* pack_changes;
   603:     // The data layout and the measurement tables; see CPreprocessDetail for
   604:     // why they are not members here. Null for hand-built results.
   605:     CPreprocessDetail* detail;
   606:     Target target;
   607:     u64 token_count;
   608:     u64 diagnostic_count;
   609:     u64 error_count;
   610:     u64 warning_count;
   611:     u64 diagnostic_capacity;
   612:     u32 file_count;
   613:     CPreprocessDialect dialect;
   614:     u32 pack_change_count;
   615: };
   616: 
   617: // Hand-built results carry no detail block and read as an all-zero one, which
   618: // is exactly what their inline members held before the split.
   619: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL BUSTER_UNUSED_DECL BUSTER_INLINE CPreprocessDetail const* c_preprocess_detail(CPreprocessResult preprocess)
   620: {
   621:     static CPreprocessDetail const c_preprocess_detail_empty = {0};
   622:     return preprocess.detail ? preprocess.detail : &c_preprocess_detail_empty;
   623: }

   663: typedef enum CTypeKind
   664: {
   665:     C_TYPE_INVALID,
   666:     C_TYPE_VOID,
   667:     C_TYPE_BOOL,
   668:     C_TYPE_CHAR,
   669:     C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR,
   670:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR,
   671:     C_TYPE_SHORT,
   672:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT,
   673:     C_TYPE_INT,
   674:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT,
   675:     C_TYPE_LONG,
   676:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG,
   677:     C_TYPE_LONG_LONG,
   678:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG,
   679:     C_TYPE_INT128,
   680:     C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128,
   681:     // IEEE-754 binary16, spelled `_Float16`.  It is a real type, not a
   682:     // storage-only alias: it has its own two-byte layout, its own rank below
   683:     // `float` in the usual arithmetic conversions, and its own place in the
   684:     // vector element ladder.  Clang's `avx512fp16intrin.h` declares
   685:     // `__m512h` out of it, which is what brought it in.
   686:     C_TYPE_FLOAT16,
   687:     C_TYPE_BFLOAT16,
   688:     C_TYPE_FLOAT,
   689:     C_TYPE_DOUBLE,
   690:     C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE,
   691:     // The three C99 complex types and the `_Float16 _Complex` extension
   692:     // beside them. Each is laid out as two contiguous elements of its
   693:     // underlying real type -- real part first -- which is both what the
   694:     // psABIs specify and what lets the IR model them as two-field
   695:     // aggregates (see c_ir_scalar_type). Clang's `_mm512_set1_pch` takes a
   696:     // `_Float16 _Complex` parameter, which is what brought the half form in.
   697:     C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX,
   698:     C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX,
   699:     C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX,
   700:     C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX,
   701:     C_TYPE_VA_LIST,
   702:     C_TYPE_NULLPTR,
   703:     C_TYPE_POINTER,
   704:     C_TYPE_ARRAY,
   705:     C_TYPE_VECTOR,
   706:     C_TYPE_FUNCTION,
   707:     C_TYPE_STRUCT,
   708:     C_TYPE_UNION,
   709:     C_TYPE_ENUM,
   710:     C_TYPE_COUNT,
   711: } CTypeKind;
   712: 
   713: // The complex kinds and their underlying real kind, in both directions. Every
   714: // complex question in the frontend goes through these three so the mapping
   715: // lives in one place; `c_type_kind_complex_of` returns C_TYPE_INVALID for a
   716: // real kind that has no complex counterpart (C only defines the three).
   717: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL BUSTER_UNUSED_DECL BUSTER_INLINE bool c_type_kind_is_complex(CTypeKind kind)
   718: {
   719:     return kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX || kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX || kind == C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX || kind == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX;
   720: }
   721: 
   722: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL BUSTER_UNUSED_DECL BUSTER_INLINE CTypeKind c_type_kind_complex_element(CTypeKind kind)
   723: {
   724:     return kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX       ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16
   725:            : kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX       ? C_TYPE_FLOAT
   726:            : kind == C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX      ? C_TYPE_DOUBLE
   727:            : kind == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE
   728:                                                 : C_TYPE_INVALID;
   729: }
   730: 
   731: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL BUSTER_UNUSED_DECL BUSTER_INLINE CTypeKind c_type_kind_complex_of(CTypeKind kind)
   732: {
   733:     return kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT16       ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX
   734:            : kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT       ? C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX
   735:            : kind == C_TYPE_DOUBLE      ? C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX
   736:            : kind == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX
   737:                                         : C_TYPE_INVALID;
   738: }
   739:

   752: typedef struct CType CType;
   753: struct CType
   754: {
   755:     String8 tag;
   756:     // The scope a tagged aggregate was declared in, so two block-scope
   757:     // definitions of one tag in sibling functions stay two types -- clang's
   758:     // xmmintrin.h defines `struct __mm_storeh_pi_struct` inside two
   759:     // intrinsics -- and a reference resolves to the innermost visible one.
   760:     // Meaningful only for struct/union/enum types with a tag; everything
   761:     // else leaves it zero, which is the file scope.
   762:     CScopeId tag_scope;
   763:     CTypeId element_type;
   764:     CTypeId return_type;
   765:     CTypeId unqualified_type;
   766:     u32 array_bound;
   767:     u32 parameter_start;
   768:     u32 parameter_count;
   769:     u32 member_start;
   770:     u32 member_count;
   771:     u32 enum_member_start;
   772:     u32 enum_member_count;
   773:     u32 definition_start;
   774:     u32 definition_token_count;
   775:     u32 vector_byte_size;
   776:     CTypeKind kind;
   777:     bool is_const;
   778:     bool is_volatile;
   779:     bool is_restrict;
   780:     bool is_atomic;
   781:     bool is_variadic;
   782:     bool is_complete;
   783:     // GNU's transparent_union: a parameter of this union type accepts an
   784:     // argument of any member's type, passed as that member's own bits.
   785:     bool is_transparent_union;
   786:     bool has_unqualified_type;
   787:     // The function type was written `()`, with no parameter list at all --
   788:     // not `(void)`, which declares zero parameters. C11 6.2.7p3 makes an
   789:     // unprototyped declaration compatible with a non-variadic prototype, so
   790:     // musl's `long __syscall_cp_asm();` and the eight-parameter prototype
   791:     // beside it declare one function rather than two conflicting ones.
   792:     bool is_unprototyped;
   793: };
   794: 
   795: typedef struct CMember CMember;
   796: struct CMember
   797: {
   798:     String8 name;
   799:     CSourceLocation location;
   800:     CTypeId type;
   801:     u32 alignment_start;
   802:     u32 alignment_count;
   803:     u32 bit_width;
   804:     u32 bit_width_token_start;
   805:     u32 bit_width_token_count;
   806:     bool is_bit_field;
   807:     // A GNU `packed` attribute on this member alone
   808:     // (`struct { char c; int i __attribute__((packed)); }`): the member is
   809:     // placed at byte alignment, which also stops it from raising the
   810:     // aggregate's own alignment.
   811:     bool is_packed;
   812:     u8 reserved[2];
   813: };
   814: 
   815: // One `_Alignas(...)` or GNU `aligned(...)` request, as either the type it
   816: // names or the token range of its constant expression. Which of the two
   817: // spellings wrote it is not stored: token_start is always two tokens past the
   818: // keyword -- the keyword and its `(` -- so c_alignment_specifier_is_standard
   819: // reads it back out of the token stream, and this table is sized at one record
   820: // per token of the translation unit, where a flag word would commit four more
   821: // bytes per token for a fact only a rejected request ever asks about.
   822: typedef struct CAlignmentSpecifier CAlignmentSpecifier;
   823: struct CAlignmentSpecifier
   824: {
   825:     CTypeId type;
   826:     u32 token_start;
   827:     u32 token_count;
   828: };
   829: 
   830: // The GNU attributes a struct or union definition carries on the definition
   831: // itself, either before the tag (`struct __attribute__((packed)) P { ... }`)
   832: // or after the closing brace (`struct P { ... } __attribute__((packed));`).
   833: // They live in a side table rather than in CType because the population is a
   834: // handful of aggregates in a translation unit while the type table is tens of
   835: // thousands of entries: a flag word per type would grow every one of them.
   836: // Both layout engines -- the sizeof folding in c_parse.c and the IR layout in
   837: // c_gen.c -- read this table, and they must agree or a folded sizeof
   838: // contradicts the object it sizes.
   839: typedef struct CAggregateAttributes CAggregateAttributes;
   840: struct CAggregateAttributes
   841: {
   842:     u32 type_index;
   843:     // Range into CParseResult.alignments, as CMember/CDeclaration name theirs.
   844:     u32 alignment_start;
   845:     u32 alignment_count;
   846:     bool is_packed;
   847:     u8 reserved[3];
   848: };
   849: 
   850: // The alignment a declarator wrote on the *type* it declares rather than on an
   851: // object it declares: `typedef int cache_line __attribute__((aligned(64)))`.
   852: // GNU `aligned` there sets the alignment of the type, so unlike every other
   853: // alignment record in this file it *replaces* the natural alignment instead of
   854: // raising it, and it is the one place the attribute lowers one without
   855: // `packed` -- `typedef int pair __attribute__((aligned(2)))` is two-byte
   856: // aligned in both GCC and Clang. The record keys on the alias copy the
   857: // declarator made, never on the type it aliases, so `int` keeps its own
   858: // alignment -- and on every qualified copy of that alias, because a qualifier
   859: // cannot take an alignment away and the qualified copy points past the alias
   860: // at the type it strips to (#714). It lives in a side table for the reason
   861: // CParseResult.noreturn_function_types does: the population is a handful of
   862: // typedefs per translation unit against a type table of tens of thousands of
   863: // entries, so a field on CType would cost every one of them.
   864: typedef struct CTypeAlignment CTypeAlignment;
   865: struct CTypeAlignment
   866: {
   867:     u32 type_index;
   868:     // Range into CParseResult.alignments, as CMember/CDeclaration name theirs.
   869:     u32 alignment_start;
   870:     u32 alignment_count;
   871: };
   872: 
   873: typedef struct CEnumMember CEnumMember;
   874: struct CEnumMember
   875: {
   876:     String8 name;
   877:     CSourceLocation location;
   878:     // Interned id of `name`, carried from the declaring token so the entity
   879:     // filed from this record is keyed without a second intern; 0 when the
   880:     // parse ran without a symbol table.  It sits in the alignment hole
   881:     // ahead of `value`, so the record's size is unchanged.
   882:     u32 symbol;
   883:     u64 value;
   884:     bool is_negative;
   885:     u8 reserved[7];
   886: };
   887: BUSTER_CT_CHECK(sizeof(CEnumMember) == 56);
   888:

   914: typedef struct CEntity CEntity;
   915: struct CEntity
   916: {
   917:     String8 name;

   919:     // the scope-lookup buckets and chains key on it.

   922:     CTypeId type;

   927:     CEntityId next_by_name;

   933:     u32 alignment_count;
   934:     CEntityKind kind;
   935:     bool is_definition;
   936:     bool is_static_storage;
   937:     bool is_thread_local;
   938:     bool is_constexpr;
   939:     bool has_constant_value;
   940:     bool constant_is_negative;
   941:     bool has_cleanup;
   942:     bool cleanup_attribute_checked;
   943:     // Register storage on a local. Only the local declarator path records it,
   944:     // and only one reader needs it: an assembler label on a `register` local
   945:     // binds a machine register instead of renaming a symbol.
   946:     bool is_register;
   947:     u8 reserved[1];
   948:     CEntityId cleanup_function;
   949:     u32 cleanup_attribute_token;
   950:     u32 cleanup_attribute_end;
   951:     u64 constant_value;
   952: };

   981: typedef enum CDeclarationKind
   982: {

   991: typedef struct CDeclaration CDeclaration;
   992: struct CDeclaration
   993: {
   994:     String8 name;
   995:     CSourceLocation location;
   996:     u32 token_start;
   997:     u32 token_count;
   998:     // The one declarator this declaration owns out of a comma-separated list,
   999:     // initializer included and the separating ',' or ';' excluded. Zero count
  1000:     // means the declaration was not split and owns its whole token range;
  1001:     // token_start/token_count always span the declaration specifiers, which
  1002:     // every declarator of the list shares.
  1003:     u32 declarator_start;
  1004:     u32 declarator_count;
  1005:     u32 body_start;
  1006:     u32 body_token_count;
  1007:     u32 parameter_start;
  1008:     u32 parameter_count;
  1009:     u32 alignment_start;
  1010:     u32 alignment_count;
  1011:     CTypeId type;
  1012:     CTypeId base_type;
  1013:     CEntityId entity;
  1014:     CScopeId scope;
  1015:     CParserDeclaration* syntax_declaration;
  1016:     CDeclarationKind kind;
  1017:     bool is_definition;
  1018:     bool is_variadic;
  1019:     bool is_constexpr;
  1020:     // Set on the second and later declarators of a list: the specifiers were
  1021:     // already parsed for the first one, so base_type is supplied rather than
  1022:     // recomputed.
  1023:     bool is_declarator_continuation;
  1024: };
